title: How Computational Fluid Dynamics Works
summary: How CFD simulates fluid flow to solve real engineering problems.

scenes.title: Unlocking Fluid Secrets with CFD
scenes.narration: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is a digital superpower, allowing us to predict how liquids and gases move. It's like having X-ray vision for airflow or water currents, saving billions in physical testing.

scenes.title: Discretizing the Domain
scenes.narration: CFD starts by breaking a continuous physical space into a finite number of tiny, interconnected cells, creating a mesh. Imagine turning a smooth river into a grid of small, manageable puddles for easier analysis.

scenes.title: Solving Governing Equations
scenes.narration: Within each mesh cell, CFD applies Navier-Stokes equations, which describe conservation of mass, momentum, and energy. These complex partial differential equations are then numerically solved, often requiring powerful supercomputers.

scenes.title: Designing Faster Aircraft
scenes.narration: In aerospace, CFD simulates airflow over aircraft wings, identifying areas of high drag or lift. This allows engineers to optimize wing shapes digitally, reducing fuel consumption by up to 15% before building physical prototypes.

scenes.title: Impact Across Industries
scenes.narration: CFD is indispensable, from designing efficient wind turbines 🌬️ to modeling blood flow in arteries 🏥. It enables rapid prototyping, cost reduction, and enhanced safety, driving innovation across countless engineering fields.
